topic.label: Financial Data and Models
topic.desc: The data and models finance runs on: market and reference data, fundamentals and filings data, economic data, financial modeling in spreadsheets and code, and data quality.

concepts: Prices, quotes, trades, corporate actions, identifiers (ticker, CUSIP, ISIN, FIGI) and data vendors.
Standardized financial statements, XBRL, estimates and transcripts.
GDP, inflation, employment, interest rates and other macro series and their release calendars.
Three-statement models, DCF, LBO, merger and budget models, in spreadsheets and code, with assumptions and checks.
Checking financial data: gaps, outliers, restatements, survivorship and lineage.
skills: Maps a security between ticker, CUSIP, ISIN and FIGI and flags mismatches.
Chooses a market data source by coverage, latency, history and cost.
Extracts financial statement values from XBRL filings with their tags and periods.
Finds the official series for an economic indicator and its release schedule.
Builds a linked three-statement model with assumptions separated from formulas.
Audits a financial model for broken links, hard-coded numbers and balance sheet that does not balance.
Checks a price series for gaps, outliers, splits and stale values.
mcp: Financial Datasets MCP server: company income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, stock prices and market news.
FRED MCP server: Federal Reserve Economic Data series, interest rates, inflation, GDP, employment and economic indicators.
SEC EDGAR MCP server: company filings, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, XBRL financial data and insider trading forms from EDGAR.
Polygon.io MCP server: market data for stocks, options, indices, forex and crypto, aggregates, trades, quotes, reference data and financials.
